title: CHGR shared envelope definitions
description: The universal chgr_envelope fields every records/*.schema.json file composes via allOf (Phase 143E), plus the shared timestamp shape. Mirrors the shape of src/pcae/schema_resources/cltr_cutover/shared/envelope.schema.json but is a wholly separate, independently defined file (CHGR-001 Sec.16/Sec.19.1: no composition across artifact families). chgr_envelope carries no additionalProperties:false of its own; the owning records/*.schema.json file supplies the single additionalProperties closure.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, explicit 'Z' suffix only, seconds required, optional 1-6 fractional digits. Validates shape only -- never freshness, expiry, monotonicity, or clock skew.

schema_version.description: This schema file's own MAJOR.MINOR version string.

schema_id.description: Always present. Const per owning file, identifying which CHGR artifact type the document is.

schema_version.description: Always present. This file's own version.

contract_version.description: Always present. Identifies which version of CHGR-001 the schema was generated against.

record_type.description: Always present. Const per owning file, one of the closed CHGR record_family values.

record_digest.description: Always present. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

chgr_envelope.description: The 7 universal envelope fields every CHGR artifact type composes via allOf.
